form: Line chart with observed-point markers and a gap for missing February
supportedFinding: Recorded registrations were 10 in January, 18 in March and 16 in April 2026. March to April declined by 2. The full monthly path is unknown because February was not recorded.
populationAndMeasure: Monthly enrolment counts are registrations, not completions. Unique-participant counts and a participant denominator are not supplied.

labels: All three observed values directly labelled; February explicitly labelled not recorded
uncertainty: February null is missing, not zero; no interpolation, no line over the gap. No intervals supplied. No four-month total or rate is inferred.
transformations: Raw integer counts retained; month names abbreviated only for axis labels.
source: Synthetic curriculum and enrolment register, 2026; not real participant data.
